stem.text: The top row of bars represents a set of particles inside the Earth and at rest.
The lower row represents the same particles at one instant as a longitudinal wave passes from left to right through the Earth.

stem.alt: Two rows of vertical bars: the top row evenly spaced, the lower row with uneven spacing between bars.

stem.text: What should be measured to determine the amplitude of the oscillations of the particles in the lower row as the wave passes?

A.text: half the maximum displacement of the particles from their position at rest

B.text: half the maximum distance apart of the particles

C.text: the maximum displacement of the particles from their position at rest

D.text: the maximum distance apart of the particles
